description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractThingAdapter' for handling thing commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It sets up pattern mappings for various thing-related paths and provides a constructor to initialize the adapter with specific mapping strategies and header translation.

classes.name: AbstractThingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for adapters handling thing commands, providing path pattern mappings and initialization logic.

methods.name: AbstractThingAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with mapping strategies, header translator, and payload path patterns.
